subs: What if countries went to war with their FIFA ranking? Let's find out!
Round one: Europe! The home of football!
Round two: South America! Argentina or Brazil?
Round three: Africa! Morocco is the boss here.
Tanzania holds on! Rwanda is out!
Togo declares war on Burkina Faso!
It backfires! Sudan takes the DR Congo!
Qatar holds on! Bahrain is out!
Round five: Asia! Japan against the giants.
Brave move! Thailand goes after China!
China holds on! Vietnam is out!
North Korea is weaker, but it attacks Russia anyway!
Round six: North America! Mexico against the USA.
The USA wins! Canada is gone!
Qualifiers are over! Only the best teams go on!
Qualifiers are over! Only the best teams go on!
Final rounds! Only the big teams are left.
Top five! One more team has to fall.
Semi-finals! Spain against England, and France against the USA!
What an upset! England beats Spain!
France declares war on the USA!
What an upset! The USA beats France!
The final! England against the USA!
Way too easy for the USA!
The USA is the world champion of war!
